description: Loop a forward-leaning sprint in place toward RIGHT. Keep the deep lean throughout, shoulders ahead of hips. Strong alternating strides with clear front contact, push-off, folded rear heel and brief flight; legs remain readable below the short coat. At contact the hips and chest compress slightly; extend on push-off while the head stays steady. Cloth tails stream LEFT and ripple with delayed tips. Keep the sword arm BENT, hand firmly gripping the GOLD hilt BEHIND the hip; the same short thick gold sword trails LEFT, slightly downward, angled to the forearm. Small natural arm movement; hand, guard and blade stay connected, fixed blade length. Free bent arm counterbalances near the chest. No giant arm swings. Preserve the cream hood, one amber eye, waist bell, short body and original palette. No attack, effects, extra hands or weapons. Fixed camera, root, scale and ground line. One seamless eight-pose loop, end at matching running phase, never stand upright or pause.
subject_description: The exact small cream-hooded bellkeeper: oversized hood, dark face with one amber eye, short navy body, cream shoulder cloth/split hem/boots, one gold waist bell, gold gloves and one short thick gold sword held behind the hip.
initial_pose: Already sprinting to the right, low forward torso lean, bent sword arm behind the hip and short gold sword trailing left, one knee forward, other leg bent back.
